passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron: “The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it, each man under his standard, with the banners of his family.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron.
He gave them instructions.
The Israelites must camp around the Tent of Meeting.
They must not camp too close to the Tent.
Each man must camp under his own standard.
Each family must have its own banner.
Each family must camp together.
The Israelites must follow these instructions.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה וְאֶֽל־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לֵאמֹֽר׃ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־ דִּגְל֤וֹ בְאֹתֹת֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם יַחֲנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִנֶּ֕גֶד סָבִ֥יב לְאֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֖ד יַחֲנֽוּ׃

passages.text: On the east side, toward the sunrise, the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard: The leader of the descendants of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab, and his division numbers 74,600.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Judah camped on the east side.
The east side is toward the sunrise.
Judah camped under their own standard.
Judah camped by their divisions.
Nahshon was the leader of the tribe of Judah.
Nahshon was the son of Amminadab.
The division of Judah had 74,600 men.
passages.original: וְהַחֹנִים֙ קֵ֣דְמָה מִזְרָ֔חָה דֶּ֛גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה יְהוּדָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־ עַמִּינָדָֽב׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it. The leader of the Issacharites is Nethanel son of Zuar, and his division numbers 54,400.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Issachar will camp next to the tribe of Judah.
Nethanel is the leader of the tribe of Issachar.
Nethanel is the son of Zuar.
The division of Issachar has 54,400 men.
passages.original: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּעָֽר׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃ס

passages.text: Next will be the tribe of Zebulun. The leader of the Zebulunites is Eliab son of Helon, and his division numbers 57,400.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Zebulun will camp next.
Eliab is the leader of the Zebulunites.
Eliab is the son of Helon.
The division of Zebulun has 57,400 men.
passages.original: מַטֵּ֖ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־ חֵלֹֽן׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400; they shall set out first.
passages.sermon:
The camp of Judah has many men.
The total number is 186,400.
These men belong to the divisions of Judah.
They will set out first.
passages.original: כָּֽל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה יְהוּדָ֗ה מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְשֵֽׁשֶׁת־ אֲלָפִ֥ים וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵא֖וֹת לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם רִאשֹׁנָ֖ה יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס

passages.text: On the south side, the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Reubenites is Elizur son of Shedeur, and his division numbers 46,500.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Reuben will camp on the south side.
They will camp by their divisions.
They will camp under their standard.
Elizur is the leader of the Reubenites.
Elizur is the son of Shedeur.
His division has 46,500 men.
passages.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֧ה רְאוּבֵ֛ן תֵּימָ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־ שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדָ֑יו שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it. The leader of the Simeonites is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai, and his division numbers 59,300.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Simeon will camp next to the tribe of Reuben.
Shelumiel is the leader of the Simeonites.
Shelumiel is the son of Zurishaddai.
The division of Simeon has 59,300 men.
passages.original: וְהַחוֹנִ֥ם עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּרִֽי־ שַׁדָּֽי׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel, and his division numbers 45,650.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Gad will camp next.  
Eliasaph is the leader of the Gadites.  
Eliasaph is the son of Deuel.  
The division of Gad has 45,650 men.
passages.original: וְמַטֵּ֖ה גָּ֑ד וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ רְעוּאֵֽל׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

passages.text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450; they shall set out second.
passages.sermon:
The camp of Reuben has several divisions.
The total number of men in these divisions is 151,450.
These men belong to the camp of Reuben.
The camp of Reuben will set out second.
passages.original: כָּֽל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֗ן מְאַ֨ת אֶ֜לֶף וְאֶחָ֨ד וַחֲמִשִּׁ֥ים אֶ֛לֶף וְאַרְבַּע־ מֵא֥וֹת וַחֲמִשִּׁ֖ים לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁנִיִּ֖ם יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס

passages.text: In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a tribe in Israel.
The Levites camp in the middle of the other tribes.
The Tent of Meeting is with the Levites.
The Tent of Meeting travels with the Levites.
The Levites move in the center of the camps.
The Levites set out in the same order as they camped.
Each man travels in his own place.
Each man travels under his own standard.
passages.original: וְנָסַ֧ע אֹֽהֶל־ מוֹעֵ֛ד מַחֲנֵ֥ה הַלְוִיִּ֖ם בְּת֣וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֹ֑ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר יַחֲנוּ֙ כֵּ֣ן יִסָּ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ עַל־ יָד֖וֹ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: On the west side, the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Ephraimites is Elishama son of Ammihud, and his division numbers 40,500.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Ephraim camps on the west side.
They camp under their own standard.
Elishama is their leader.
Elishama is the son of Ammihud.
The division of Ephraim has 40,500 men.
passages.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה אֶפְרַ֛יִם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם יָ֑מָּה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־ עַמִּיהֽוּד׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to it. The leader of the Manassites is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur, and his division numbers 32,200.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Manasseh will camp next to the tribe of Ephraim.
Gamaliel is the leader of the tribe of Manasseh.
Gamaliel is the son of Pedahzur.
The division of Manasseh has 32,200 men.
passages.original: וְעָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָהצֽוּר׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Next will be the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjamites is Abidan son of Gideoni, and his division numbers 35,400.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Benjamin comes next.
Abidan is the leader of the Benjamites.
Abidan is the son of Gideoni.
The division of Benjamin has 35,400 men.
passages.original: וּמַטֵּ֖ה בִּנְיָמִ֑ן וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־ גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100; they shall set out third.
passages.sermon:
The camp of Ephraim has several divisions.
The total number of men in these divisions is 108,100.
These men are counted for their armies.
The camp of Ephraim will set out third.
passages.original: כָּֽל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֞ים לְמַחֲנֵ֣ה אֶפְרַ֗יִם מְאַ֥ת אֶ֛לֶף וּשְׁמֹֽנַת־ אֲלָפִ֥ים וּמֵאָ֖ה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וּשְׁלִשִׁ֖ים יִסָּֽעוּ׃ס

passages.text: On the north side, the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard: The leader of the Danites is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, and his division numbers 62,700.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Dan will camp on the north side.
They will camp under their own standard.
Ahiezer is the leader of the Danites.
Ahiezer is the son of Ammishaddai.
The division of Dan has 62,700 men.
passages.original: דֶּ֣גֶל מַחֲנֵ֥ה דָ֛ן צָפֹ֖נָה לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The tribe of Asher will camp next to it. The leader of the Asherites is Pagiel son of Ocran, and his division numbers 41,500.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Asher will camp next to the camp of Dan.
Pagiel is the leader of the tribe of Asher.
Pagiel is the son of Ocran.
The division of Asher has 41,500 men.
passages.original: וְהַחֹנִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עָכְרָֽן׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֧ד וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Next will be the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites is Ahira son of Enan, and his division numbers 53,400.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Naphtali will camp next. 
Ahira is the leader of the Naphtalites. 
Ahira is the son of Enan. 
The division of Naphtali has 53,400 men.
passages.original: וּמַטֵּ֖ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י וְנָשִׂיא֙ לִבְנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־ עֵינָֽן׃ וּצְבָא֖וֹ וּפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600; they shall set out last, under their standards.”
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Dan is one of the tribes of Israel.
The camp of Dan has 157,600 men.
These men belong to the divisions of Dan.
The camp of Dan will travel last.
They will march under their own standards.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַפְּקֻדִים֙ לְמַ֣חֲנֵה דָ֔ן מְאַ֣ת אֶ֗לֶף וְשִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת לָאַחֲרֹנָ֥ה יִסְע֖וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: These are the Israelites, numbered according to their families. The total of those counted in the camps, by their divisions, was 603,550.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites are the people God brought out of Egypt.
They belong to different families.
Leaders counted the Israelites by their families.
They counted all the men who could serve in the army.
They organized the people into camps and divisions.
The total number of men counted in all the camps was 603,550.
passages.original: אֵ֛לֶּה פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ פְּקוּדֵ֤י הַֽמַּחֲנֹת֙ לְצִבְאֹתָ֔ם שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֙לֶף֙ וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

passages.text: But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a tribe of Israel.
The Levites are not included in the census of the other Israelites.
The LORD commanded Moses to exclude the Levites from the count.
Moses obeyed the LORD’s command.
passages.original: וְהַ֨לְוִיִּ֔ם לֹ֣א הָתְפָּקְד֔וּ בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶֽׁה׃

passages.text: So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses; they camped under their standards in this way and set out in the same way, each man with his clan and his family.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites obeyed the LORD.
The LORD gave commands to Moses.
The Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses.
They camped under their standards.
They set out in the same way.
Each man stayed with his clan.
Each man stayed with his family.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה כֵּֽן־ חָנ֤וּ לְדִגְלֵיהֶם֙ וְכֵ֣ן נָסָ֔עוּ אִ֥ישׁ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖יו עַל־ בֵּ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽיו׃
